steps.run: mkdir -p .github/logs; AGENT="${COPILOT_AGENT:-unknown}"; SAFE=$(echo "$AGENT" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9_-'); COUNTER_FILE=".github/logs/.edit-count-${SAFE}"; COUNT=$(cat "$COUNTER_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); case "$COUNT" in ''|*[!0-9]*) COUNT=0;; esac; IS_CODING_AGENT=false; case "$AGENT" in PrincipalAlpha|PrincipalBeta|StaffEngineerAlpha|StaffEngineerBeta|MidCoderAlpha|MidCoderBeta) IS_CODING_AGENT=true;; esac; if [ "$IS_CODING_AGENT" = "true" ] && [ "$COUNT" -gt 5 ]; then echo ""; echo "[POST-DEV] ======================================="; echo "[POST-DEV]  AUTO-ANALYSIS HOOK TRIGGERED"; echo "[POST-DEV]  Agent: $AGENT made $COUNT edits"; echo "[POST-DEV]  Threshold: >5 edits triggers analysis"; echo "[POST-DEV]  Action: Orchestrator should dispatch"; echo "[POST-DEV]  T5 Analyst for structure validation"; echo "[POST-DEV]  and doc consistency check."; echo "[POST-DEV] ======================================="; echo ""; echo "[POST-DEV-TRIGGER] agent=$SAFE edits=$COUNT threshold=5 at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log; fi

AGENT="${COPILOT_AGENT:-unknown}"; IS_CODING_AGENT=false; case "$AGENT" in PrincipalAlpha|PrincipalBeta|StaffEngineerAlpha|StaffEngineerBeta|MidCoderAlpha|MidCoderBeta) IS_CODING_AGENT=true;; esac; if [ "$IS_CODING_AGENT" = "true" ]; then CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); STAGED_FILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); TOTAL=$((CHANGED_FILES + STAGED_FILES)); if [ "$TOTAL" -gt 10 ]; then echo "[POST-DEV] $TOTAL files modified — comprehensive doc update recommended"; echo "[POST-DEV-FILES] agent=$AGENT changed_files=$TOTAL at $(date -u +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')" >> .github/logs/agent-activity.log; fi; fi
